question.text: Which of the following statements is not true?

options.text: Chain growth polymerisation involves homopoly-merisation only
Chain growth polymerisation includes both homo-polymerisation and copolymerisation
Nylon 6 is an example of step-growth polymerisation
Step growth polymerisation requires a bifunctional monomer

solution.text: The statement (b) is not true. Chain growth polymerisation (or addition polymerisation) involves homopolymerisation only Examples of such polymers include polythene, orlon and teflon.
